role: bounded adapter capability record; NOT a production original issuer, NOT a clearance, NOT an actor installation

archival_known_at_upper_year.kind: typed caller metadata on evaluate / read_selected_world
archival_known_at_upper_year.meaning: a dated archive snapshot bound: a wave is knowable in that snapshot only if published_year <= bound
archival_known_at_upper_year.separation: target valid time (observation/valid-at clock) and archival snapshot known-at time are separate clocks
archival_known_at_upper_year.enforcement: waves published after the bound are excluded from admissibility in BOTH AS_OF and RETROSPECTIVE modes; when no support remains the adapter returns explicit no-support with refused_code=ARCHIVAL_KNOWN_AT_BOUND_EXCEEDED; it never synthesizes snapshot knowledge
archival_known_at_upper_year.absent_bound: no snapshot is claimed; the supplied archive remains a caller precondition and is disclosed as such

source_grant.kind: typed caller metadata (SourceGrant: grant_source_family, grant_edition, grant_current, grant_source_owner)
source_grant.meaning: an asserted issuer grant for a source-family/edition
checks: grant_source_owner covers the used basis when supplied

outcomes.verified: SOURCE_GRANT_VERIFIED (recorded; never inferred from metadata presence)

source_grant.no_synthetic_authority: the adapter never fabricates a production original issuer or a faked clearance; a missing issuer produces HOLD/UNAVAILABLE
